reviewer_role: Sequence story/control author, reviewing actual generated images independently before lead verdict; not blind to authored intent.
review_scope: Causal chain from closed gate through failed crank to successful rim turn and passage
Traceable anatomical hands and actual rim/wood/palm contact
Two-piece break and persistent right-hand remnant
Adult identities and distinct readable expressions
One same-scale creature, four tentacles, consistent screen travel
Actual continuous phone reader after panels registered
retry_policy: Lead controls at most six remaining concrete sequence hard-failure retries. This reviewer records failure evidence; no generation or approval inference.
